source_steps: Public Copy wrapper forwards to implementation; no Clone callback is executed.
Length mismatch invokes panic before any memory write; same complete Result failure class.
Equal lengths invoke only argument-confined non-overlapping memory copy. Concrete u8 Copy; exclusive destination/source borrow supplies non-overlap; intrinsic semantics remain V370.
Buffer double slicing preserves first base<=length then count<=remaining checks. The changed window is reinserted with both untouched prefix and suffix. Empty copy retains all dead buffer bytes.
missing: Full BlockBuffer.digest_blocks/get_pos/set_pos control-flow/ordered-callback and typed Eager split carrier transport; only the original compression callback may remain parametric.
